target: laboon XFCE desktop, x11vnc TCP 5905 / verification 5906, macOS arm64
method: adversarial swarm (recon + refutation + synthesis) plus live witnessed execution in laboon guests

claims.claim: The 'Failed to open PTY: Not a tty' error is caused by laboon lacking PTY support
evidence: pty.openpty() -> OPENPTY_OK 3 4 /dev/pts/8 in a laboon guest
claims.root_cause: Linux TIOCPKT (0x5420) was absent from internal/sandbox/lx_termios.go constants and the ttyIoctl/ptmxIoctl switches; the default returned sErr(lxENOTTY). Live probe: TIOCGPTN / TIOCGPTLCK / TIOCSPTLCK / TIOCGPTPEER / TIOCGWINSZ all OK, TIOCPKT(0x5420) FAIL errno=25 ENOTTY.

claims.claim: The terminal can be fixed with a small Go change
fix: internal/sandbox/pty_unix.go: guarded case in ptmxIoctl forwards TIOCPKT to the host pty master with unix.IoctlSetPointerInt
internal/sandbox/termios_unix.go: guarded case in ttyIoctl for the slave
go build ./cmd/laboon -> Mach-O arm64; gofmt clean; go test ./internal/oci/... ./internal/sandbox/... pass
witness: probe/tiocpkt-direct.txt: fcntl.ioctl(master, TIOCPKT, struct.pack('i',1)) -> TIOCPKT_OK /dev/pts/13; off variant also OK
probe/native2.png: xfce4-terminal shows uid=0(root) gid=0(root) and Linux laboon 6.8.0 aarch64
probe/native3-typed.png: command typed through VNC (RFB KeyEvent) echoed, executed and showed VNC_NATIVE_TERMINAL_OK / uid=0(root) / Linux laboon 6.8.0 / prompt / #
no PTY error dialog in vte2.log / vte3.log
claims.root_cause_refinement: Two independent defects: (1) TIOCPKT was unhandled -> ENOTTY; (2) returning success without enabling packet mode left VTE reading a stream it could not frame, so the window stayed black. Forwarding with unix.IoctlSetInt passed the int value as the ioctl pointer, giving EFAULT ('Bad address'); TIOCPKT takes a pointer to int, so unix.IoctlSetPointerInt is the correct form on both Darwin (0x80047470) and Linux (0x5420). xfce4-terminal ignores terminalrc; colors must go into Xfconf (xfce4-terminal.xml).

claims.claim: A PTY-free pipe command console displayed in Chromium gives a working terminal over VNC
claims.note: The pipe console is no longer the shipped default terminal: the native xfce4-terminal works after the TIOCPKT fix. It is retained as a hardened fallback.
evidence: guest FIFO console -> PIPE_CONSOLE_OK, uid=0(root), DONE
POST /run -> 200 with LABOON_CONSOLE_OK / uid=0(root) / Linux laboon 6.8.0 aarch64 / exit=0
RFB KeyEvent/PointerEvent injection typed 'echo VNC_TYPED_OK; id' into the Chromium console and the framebuffer showed VNC_TYPED_OK / uid=0(root) gid=0(root) / exit 0 (terminal-console-typed.png)

adjacent_fixes: removed xfce4-pulseaudio-plugin: it loads libpulse and triggered the same pa_mutex_new() abort, producing a blocking 'Plugin Restart' dialog
wrote a custom xfce4-panel.xml with only working plugins (no pulseaudio, no notification, no undefined plugin-7)
dock and Applications-menu terminal launchers point at the native xfce4-terminal (laboon-terminal.desktop); the browser console is only a fallback
disable xfwm4 compositing via xfconf XML so scrot captures the real desktop
install exact X diagnostics, fonts, mousepad, pm-utils, xrdb, xdotool
start x11vnc before startxfce4 (VNC ready in 7s)
replace fixed 'sleep 7100' with an indefinite loop bounded by the outer gtimeout

hardened terminal-console.py after adversarial review: 127.0.0.1-only bind, Origin/Host checks, application/json required, 64 KiB body cap, 1 MiB output cap, 400 on malformed input instead of 500, no-store/nosniff headers

console_security_verdict.evidence: adversarial verifier: guest uid=0 is an emulated Linux credential; host supervisor runs as uid 501; listener is guest loopback 127.0.0.1 only; no host-path syscall, no wildcard bind, no control-plane call. Explicitly UNSAFE if run on the host (no laboon boundary) - hardening above applied anyway.

surfaced_not_imposed.issue: x11vnc -nopw is wildcard-bound (*:5905, IPv4+IPv6) and LAN-reachable: an adversarial verifier completed an RFB handshake against the host LAN address 192.168.1.76:5905
surfaced_not_imposed.why_not_silently_fixed: setting a VNC password changes how the user connects; -localhost is NOT a valid fix (live probe showed it silently breaks laboon -net port forwarding, host connections refused)
surfaced_not_imposed.mitigation: x11vnc -rfbauth <vncpasswd> and vncviewer -passwd <file>; documented in README.md. The shipped default stays passwordless for a working local connection.

remaining_limitations: xfce4-power-manager CRITICALs, xfdesktop GLib-CRITICAL and missing /sys/class/backlight, UPower, PolicyKit and DPMS are expected under laboon's synthetic /sys and Xvfb
guest /dev/pts directory enumeration is synthetic (no slave nodes listed), though open-by-path works
